title: The cats LOVE this
text: Our 4 cats are on their second box and they love it. I promised my daughter to wait till she got home to open the second box we received because it's so entertaining to watch them divide up the contents. They start by each smelling the box then when it's open they take their favorite catnip infused toy. Then they take turns sitting in the empty box. Well worth it to me.
label: positive
